records.text: Intake diagnostic with Priya. Integer operations: secure, 9 of 10. Ratios and proportions: secure. Percent problems: secure. Fraction division: shaky, she flips the wrong fraction about half the time. Two-step equations: shaky, 5 of 10.
Worked on two-step equations with balance diagrams. Priya liked the visual model. Homework set of 12.
Two-step equations quiz with Priya: 9 of 10. Secure for now.
Scientific notation quiz with Priya: 8 of 8 on writing very large and very small numbers with powers of ten. Secure.
Fraction division practice with area models. Priya still slips when a mixed number is involved.
Multi-step equations with variables on both sides: Priya scored 7 of 8. Secure.
Slope from two points and from a table: Priya scored 9 of 10. Secure. Last session before the summer break.

Back-to-school check with Priya after the summer break. Integer operations, ratios, percent problems, multi-step equations and slope all held up: secure. Fraction division still slips with mixed numbers. Two-step equations with negative numbers: 3 of 6, shaky again after the summer.
Graphing linear functions from a table and from an equation: Priya scored 6 of 6. Secure.
Introduced exponent rules with Priya: product and quotient of powers. She worked through ten examples with prompting. Homework set.
More exponent rules with Priya: power of a power and the zero exponent. Homework was complete and neat.
Last session with Owen. Reviewed slope and graphing with Priya ahead of the handover.

Handover note for Priya from Owen Hale: strong on equations and graphing, and slope is solid. Fraction division still slips, and so do negatives in two-step equations. We have started exponents. She likes visual models and timed challenges.
Intake check with Leo. Integer operations, fractions, ratios, percent problems, two-step and multi-step equations: all secure.
Slope and graphing linear functions with Leo: 9 of 10. Secure.
Exponent rules quiz with Leo: 10 of 10, including the zero exponent and negative exponents. Secure.
Scientific notation quiz with Leo: 7 of 8. Secure.
Pythagorean theorem quiz with Leo: 5 of 8. Shaky: he squares the legs, then forgets to take the square root of the sum.
Introduced systems of equations with Leo by graphing two lines and reading the crossing point.
Handover note for Leo from Owen Hale: secure on Unit 6 except the Pythagorean theorem, where he forgets the square root. Systems of equations just started.

today_records.text: Fifteen-minute check with Priya, first session after the handover (Mara Lind). Exponent rules: secure, 7 of 8. Scientific notation: shaky, she drops the minus sign on the power of ten for small numbers, 3 of 6. Pythagorean theorem: shaky, she finds the hypotenuse but cannot find a missing leg, 2 of 5.
